caveats: All image diagnostic accuracies use the fixed 40 held-out marking and 40 test images except Fashion-full (200 each).
Fresh baseline replay first differs from original training activity at sample 60 despite matching seed/init/order; bitwise reproducibility is not established.
Morrison comparisons are 10-second transients, not equilibria or a full replication of the paper.
Plastic update counts are traversals of STDP event handlers, including zero-delta events; external Poisson multiplicities are excluded.
Stored raw checkpoints and simulator source were not altered; normalization diagnostics operate on in-memory inference copies.
